motivation: Phase-2 hostile review (F-1/F-2): the frozen C3 experiment contains no positive regime and thus cannot support a statement about whether the model CAN exhibit traveling waves; only a negative statement about the tested regime. A-1b prospectively searches the same codebase (identical substrate, estimator, thresholds) over a predeclared family of distance-dependent conduction delays for a regime in which the estimator classifies TRAVELING_WAVE.
separation_of_concerns: A-1a validated the estimator on injected synthetic fields (48-case recovery surface PASS). A-1b runs the actual neural model on the identical estimator. The estimator is the D1-repaired module (see a1a_receipt repairs); its frozen thresholds are unchanged.

geometry_and_topology.positions: ordered arc-length positions x_i = R*theta_i, theta_i = 2*pi*i/N (identical to frozen C3 ordered conditions)
geometry_and_topology.directed_edge_convention: skip m connects neuron i to neuron (i + m) mod n; edge blocks ordered by skip 1..K, each block ordered by pre index
geometry_and_topology.connectivity_radius_note: K is the propagation range in ring steps; each neuron receives K presynaptic inputs

delay_family.units: v_c in mm/ms, dt_delay = 0.5 ms (simulation dt), delay_steps dimensionless integer >= 1
delay_family.computation: signature vectors were computed and verified identically in float64 and float32 arithmetic BEFORE any outcome was observed (p2v_a1b_prefreeze_evidence.json); the spec embeds the exact integer vectors and the runner uses them verbatim - no runtime ceiling, no adaptive choice
delay_family.quantization_note: 15/15 (v_c, K) points map to distinct delay vectors; quantization plateaus (equal integer delays across arcs) are recorded in the pre-freeze evidence, not collapsed

anchor_point.criterion: construction identity, not classification identity: edges and emitter bitwise equal to the frozen ordered_uniform path AND V_m traces bitwise equal to the frozen ordered_uniform replay for all three seeds (pre-freeze evidence, all True)
anchor_point.status_if_failed: point executed normally but reported with anchor_identity flag false and relabeled 'nearby control' - lattice, criteria, and outcomes unchanged

simulation_policy.initialization: identical to frozen C3: Configuration.runtime(seed=...) + Simulation(seed=...) path; per-neuron Izhikevich initial state v0=-65, u0=0

estimator.positions_input: ordered arc-length positions (all points use ordered layout; geometry shuffle is not part of A-1b)
estimator.direction_convention: wave_vector sign canonicalized as in frozen C1 records (raw k_hat = -k_true convention); direction errors reported in degrees

classification_and_outcomes.invalid_run_criteria: any NaN/Inf in V_m OR max|V_m| > 150 mV OR estimator outputs non-finite values
classification_and_outcomes.marginal_points_note: MARGINAL points are reported in detail but do not determine the domain outcome
classification_and_outcomes.no_adaptive_extension: the lattice, criteria, and decision tree are final; no point is added, removed, or redefined after outcomes are observed

interpretation_constraint: POSITIVE_DOMAIN_FOUND supports only: 'within the tested delay family, at least one configuration produced a TRAVELING_WAVE classification by the same estimator that classified all 60 frozen C3 cells NO_WAVE'. It does not claim biophysical generality, physiological velocity realism, or that the frozen C3 regime is other than characterized.
